subject: Clarify midpoint inclusion for SOC 2 Type II period + bridge letter timing
messages:
From: Emily Stone <e.stone@veridian-audit.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: info@veridian-audit.com
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 13:02:00 -0400
Subject: SOC 2 Type II coverage: inclusion of mid-month changes and potential bridge letter

Hi Rachel,

Quick question while we finalize the audit timeline for Acme Fintech's engagement: the report period we're testing is 2023-01-01 through 2023-12-31 (Type II). We have two related clarifications before we finish our fieldwork:

1) Point-in-time evidence: for controls that reference "end of month" snapshots, do you treat the month-end snapshot as inclusive up to 23:59:59 UTC on the last calendar day, or does your collection process capture a timestamp at 00:00:00 and therefore roll into the following day? We saw a configuration change on 2023-07-15 at 23:45 UTC in the change log and want to ensure we're attributing it to the correct reporting month.

2) Bridge letter window: if Acme requests a bridge letter to cover a gap between the Type II report cutoff and a later attestation date (example: 2024-01-01 through 2024-02-28), do you typically provide a formal bridge letter and what evidence bundle would you attach?

If you can confirm your snapshot time convention and whether Redwood is able to produce a short bridge letter + sample logs for delivery, that would help us close our procedures.

Thanks,
Emily Stone
Senior Auditor | Veridian Audit
(e) e.stone@veridian-audit.com
(t) +1 415-555-0192

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Stone <e.stone@veridian-audit.com>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 15:34:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II coverage: inclusion of mid-month changes and potential bridge letter

Emily —

Thanks for the clear questions. Looping in Chloe (Logs & Observability) and Marcus (Security Ops) to confirm the exact timestamps and to draft a short bridge letter if Acme would like one.

High level answer from my side: we treat month-end evidence as the state at 23:59:59 UTC on the last calendar day, but our internal log rotation and archival process can affect the timestamp that appears in exported artifacts. Chloe / Marcus — can you confirm:
- whether exported daily archives are stamped at 00:00:00 UTC (representing the prior day's state) or at 23:59:59 UTC of the date in the filename;
- whether we can produce a short "snapshot metadata" text file that explains the extraction point and timezone, along with one small log excerpt (no PII) showing the 2023-07-15 23:45 change;

Emily — once Chloe confirms, we can:
- provide a brief metadata text file describing extraction timing,
- include a sample log excerpt (attached),
- and prepare a one-page bridge letter covering 2024-01-01 to 2024-02-28 if Acme requests it.

Proposed next step: I can send the metadata + log excerpt and draft bridge letter by EOD Monday (Mar 22 PT) and schedule a 30-min call if you want to walk through the artifacts.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Head of Compliance Programs | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: SOC 2 Type II coverage: inclusion of mid-month changes and potential bridge letter

Rachel / Marcus — quick tech note:

- Our daily archival job runs at 00:05 UTC and creates a gzip bundle labeled with the previous day's date (e.g., "2023-07-31-logs.tar.gz" contains events up to 23:59:59 UTC on 2023-07-31). The extractor writes a metadata file at bundle creation time that records both the archive creation timestamp (00:05 UTC) and the last_event_timestamp (23:59:59 UTC).
- For change events captured at 23:45 UTC on 2023-07-15, those will be included in the 2023-07-15 bundle and therefore count toward July.
- We can produce: 1) a plain-text metadata file that states the archive creation rule and timezone, and 2) a small redacted excerpt of the change log (one file, ~10 lines) showing the 2023-07-15 23:45 event.

Note: export filenames will reflect the YYYY-MM-DD of the last_event_timestamp, even though the bundle is created slightly after midnight. That is the clearest way to show inclusivity.

Chloe
Observability Lead | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.inference.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Stone <e.stone@veridian-audit.com>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II coverage: inclusion of mid-month changes and potential bridge letter

Emily — following up with confirmed detail from our ops team:

1) Snapshot inclusivity: our exported daily archives are created at ~00:05 UTC but are labeled with the previous day's date and include events through 23:59:59 UTC on that day. Practically, the month-end snapshot should be interpreted as inclusive through 23:59:59 UTC on the last calendar day. The attached metadata file documents the extractor behavior.

2) The 2023-07-15 23:45 UTC configuration change you referenced is included in the 2023-07-15 archive and therefore counts as July activity. Attached is a redacted log excerpt showing the event timestamp and the extraction metadata.

3) Bridge letter: Redwood can provide a one-page bridge letter covering the requested window (2024-01-01 through 2024-02-28). We will staple the metadata file and one representative archive excerpt to that letter. If you'd like the bridge letter via DocuSign for signature, we can initiate that.

Next steps:
- I'll attach the metadata + excerpt and the draft bridge letter (PDF).
- Please confirm whether Veridian needs the bridge letter signed or if a customer-requested unsigned letter is sufficient for your procedures.
- If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute call Tuesday 10am PT to walk through artifacts.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Head of Compliance Programs | Redwood Inference
Attachments: 20231231-soc2-snapshot-metadata.txt, sample-log-excerpt-20230731.txt, bridge-letter-20231231-20240228.pdf
